subject: Exec roundtable — priority arrivals & overnight upgrade exception
messages:
From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@helixhealth.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: events@helixhealth.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec roundtable — travel exception request

Hi Lauren,

Quick one as we lock logistics for the May 12 executive roundtable in NYC. Two of our C-suite guests (listed in the attached CSV) need to arrive late evening on May 11 for a private prep session with our leadership team. Standard policy for vendor travel only allows same-day arrival, but given their schedules we need an overnight arrival and a modest room upgrade (single-night).

Can Redwood accommodate an exception for: 1) May 11 arrival hotel night for two attendees, and 2) one-night room type upgrade (standard -> premium) for the two? We can cover the difference if you prefer, but our procurement team would like Redwood to approve the exception in writing so we can finalize flights.

I attached the attendee file and estimated arrival window. If helpful, we can hop on a 15-min call this afternoon.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Nguyen
Senior Events Manager, Helix Health
samantha.nguyen@helixhealth.com
+1 646 555 0192

Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:03:22 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Exec roundtable — travel exception request

Kimberly / Marissa — forwarding Helix Health's ask. Two execs request early arrival night (May 11) + single-night room upgrades. Helix said they can pay the delta, but need our written exception to finalize flights.

Questions for approvals: 
- Finance (Marissa): can we approve the exception so procurement marks vendor exceptions as allowed? If we approve but Helix pays delta, do we still need an internal spend code or PO?
- Ops (Kimberly): any concerns about contract or SLA implications for early arrivals / private prep sessions at the office on May 11?

Connor, can you check capacity for the conference rooms and whether we need security escort on the evening of May 11?

I'll hold on responding to Samantha until we have a clear path.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Events (acting)
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Cc: connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:41:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Exec roundtable — travel exception request

Lauren / Kim,

FWIW from finance: we can sign off on a written exception that permits the vendor (Helix) to book May 11 arrivals and upgrades, provided the following conditions are met: 

- Helix must pay the incremental upgrade cost and supply an invoice (we will not book using Redwood corporate card).
- Expense/exception must reference spend code CC-ER-2007 and be attached to the event PO (FR-2027-0428-11).
- Limit: one-night upgrade for up to 2 external guests; cap per-room pre-tax rate at $420/night.

I'll prepare a short finance approval form and sign it — see attached draft. Once Kim confirms operational OK, I can finalize and upload to the finance portal.

Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: finance_approval_form.pdf
From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:22:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Exec roundtable — travel exception request

All — operationally OK from my side with conditions: 

- Security: we will require badge escorts for the May 11 evening session. Connor, please coordinate with security to ensure two escorts from 7:30–10:00pm and record visitor badges.
- Facilities: conference room A is available for prep; set up a privacy screen and non-recording notice.
- Travel desk: Lauren, ask Helix to route bookings through our preferred travel partner (TravelLine) so rates are visible and we can enforce the $420/night cap. If Helix chooses to pay the delta directly, travel desk can still add the upgrade as a separate line item.

Kimberly Park
VP, Customer Programs
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Quick note: please mark the expense request as an "external vendor exception" in the PO. Once Marissa uploads the signed approval, I will OK the final email to Helix.
From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@helixhealth.com>, events@helixhealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec roundtable — travel exception request

Samantha — thanks for the quick details and the attendee list. We can approve the exception with the following agreed terms: 

1) Exception approved for two external guests to arrive on May 11 (one night).
2) Single-night room upgrade allowed for those two guests; Helix will cover any upgrade delta. Redwood caps the charged rate at $420/night pre-tax.
3) Helix should route bookings through TravelLine or attach invoice showing the upgrade delta; Marissa (cc'd) will confirm the invoice matches CC-ER-2007 / PO FR-2027-0428-11.
4) Security escorts and facilities will be in place from 7:30–10:00pm on May 11 (Connor will share badge details).

Next steps: 
- Samantha, please confirm the two guest names exactly as they appear on passports and whether Helix will self-pay the upgrade delta or wants Redwood to invoice it back.
- Marissa will upload the signed finance approval (attached) to the portal; please include that reference when sending invoices.
- Connor will email you the security escort contact and arrival check-in process.

If you want to lock flights now, this confirmation should be sufficient. Happy to take a 15-min call if anything needs clarifying.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Events (acting)
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
